title: 战略与结构
prompt:
Create one independent museum-quality editorial illustration for a Chinese university Principles of Management course. Landscape 16:10. Sophisticated contemporary academic art-book photography of tactile physical spaces and models, exceptional material craftsmanship, warm ivory plaster and paper, charcoal, low-saturation deep teal, restrained brushed brass, soft natural daylight, nuanced human expressions, elegant depth and generous breathing room. Main subject centered toward the right, quiet light-toned left edge suitable for native webpage text; preserve important subjects within the central frame. This is an artistic teaching scenario, not documentary evidence. No written words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, charts, arrows, illegible signage, neon, flags, stock-photo handshakes, distorted hands, or collage borders.
Subject and content basis: A tasteful sequence of three small enterprise workshop models expands from one local workshop to connected regional sites and complementary product spaces.

review.method: 逐张检查工具返回原件及原件联系表，核对构图、主题、人体、错误文字、比例与页面关联；采用WebP同时进行解码与校验值检查
